text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad! The Hanshin JF venue is 
incredible...! The atmosphere was 
completely different from my debut race!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone running with me had so much 
confidence, they were all such cool 
Umamusume. I was really worried about 
whether I could run properly."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"And when I went to the waiting room... 
guess who was there? It was my best 
friend, Mifuyu-chan! (Trainer-san invited 
her over!)"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Now that Mifuyu-chan fired me up, there's 
no way I can show anything pathetic! 
Thanks to her, I was able to get totally 
pumped and head into the race!"
